name: Veris Vermillion
source:
A high-ranking member of the Golden branch of the Knights of Faunestra, Veris is known as quite the upstanding hero.

Strangely though, whenever there's time for work to be done, Veris tends to up and disappear. I wonder why...?

[From [url=https://chouette.itch.io/heroine-for-hire]itch.io[/url]]
